textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900

The TQ TQMxE39S is a versatile SMARC module powered by Intel's Atom x5/x7 E3900 processors, belonging to the "Apollo Lake-I" family. Designed for compact and low-power applications, this module packs a punch in terms of compute performance and media processing capabilities. It adheres to the SGET Standard SMARC 2.0/2.1, making it suitable for various embedded mobile market projects.

One standout feature of the TQMxE39S is its support for triple displays with impressive 4K UHD resolution, thanks to the integrated Intel graphics processor. This capability enhances user experience and multimedia content delivery. High-speed connectivity options, such as Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, USB 3.0, and 6Gbps SATA, ensure efficient data transfer and communication bandwidth.

With its robust design and the possibility of protective coating, the TQ TQMxE39S can withstand challenging environmental conditions. It also offers flexible memory configurations, onboard eMMC storage of up to 64 GB, and various interfaces like SPI, SDIO, and serial ports for seamless integration with the carrier board.

This SMARC module caters to the demands of low-power, compact applications while delivering impressive graphics performance and connectivity options, making it an excellent choice for embedded systems in the mobile, industrial, and multimedia sectors.

text.text:
Features

  • Triple Display Support: Capable of driving three independent displays with up to 4K UHD resolution, providing enhanced visual output.

  • Robust Design: Built to withstand challenging conditions, ensuring reliability in demanding environments.

  • High-speed Connectivity: Equipped with Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, USB 3.0, and 6Gbps SATA for efficient data transfer and communication.

  • Flexible Memory Options: Supports LPDDR4 memory configurations of 2/4/8 GB and eMMC storage ranging from 8 to 64 GB.

  • Intel Atom x5/x7 E3900 Processors: Powered by the latest generation processors, offering dual/quad-core performance with clock speeds of up to 2.5 GHz.
